subject.title: feat: ask_user follow-ups — harness convergence, channel finalization + reactions, native cards, docked web panel

question: Should existing trusted paired operator credentials be migrated to receive `operator.questions`, or should native clients require an explicit re-pair before they can use question cards?
rationale: Granting the new scope automatically preserves existing behavior but broadens credentials already issued to paired devices; requiring re-pair preserves the prior boundary but breaks an existing user path until an operator intervenes.

options.title: Migrate existing paired operator credentials
options.body: Add a narrow, tested migration for OpenClaw-issued paired operator tokens so existing Android and Apple clients retain question-card access.

options.title: Require explicit re-pair
options.body: Keep existing token scopes unchanged and present a clear in-product re-pair recovery path before native question cards are available.

recommendation.title: Migrate existing paired operator credentials
recommendation.body: Add a narrow, tested migration for OpenClaw-issued paired operator tokens so existing Android and Apple clients retain question-card access.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch and the merged base question-runtime implementation establish the affected authorization and native-client behavior.
